message: No detected input validation: The code only uses argparse defaults and dataset-loading helper calls with no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths and CSV split files; no remote fetching, checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions are present.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is performed on the training samples anywhere in the visible code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained checkpoints and weights via file paths (e.g., ckpt_to_load, ckpt_fmg arguments) but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading them.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/test splits exist, there is no signing, hashing, or isolation mechanism to protect evaluation data or metrics from tampering; only basic split-file references are used.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection is visible in the inference data-flow path; inputs are passed directly to dataloaders and models without validation.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are used directly (e.g., outputs.max(1).indices) with no probability sanity bounds, NaN guards, or calibrated threshold checks applied before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer-vision (facial expression recognition) pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
